architecture.mechanism: Lubrication failure is the primary cause of bearing failure in transmission systems, and improving lubrication technology restores bearing dependability and transmission efficiency.
architecture.intervention: Inspect and replace degraded transmission fluid and lubricate all internal bearings and gear sets to eliminate friction-induced failures causing clunking and hesitation during gear shifts.
architecture.expected_effect: Restored smooth gear engagement, elimination of clunking and hesitation, cleared ESC and transmission disruption warning codes, and preserved drivability in the low-mileage vehicle.
architecture.falsification_test: Perform a tribological analysis of the transmission fluid for contamination or degradation; if lubricant is found degraded, flush and replace with manufacturer-specified fluid, then test-drive to verify absence of shifting disruption and ESC warnings.
